propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() method body spans 342 lines (49% of runner.py at 699 LOC), exceeding ADR 0056's projected 60-90 line target, making the method difficult to maintain and blocking concurrent work.
Four inline kwargs-building fragments and two post-call telemetry blocks are scattered across run() and must be extracted into separate functions to meet the ADR's decomposition goals.

Three functions (build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, record_call_spend) must be moved from runner.py into a new leaf module agent_call.py without changing behavior, signatures crossing module boundaries, or requiring monkeypatch repoints.

The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py at its current location to preserve monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) semantics; web_caps is passed as a parameter to avoid silent patch defeat.
Extraction reduces PydanticAIRunner.run() from 342 to 300 lines and runner.py from 699 to 658 LOC, while agent_call.py clears the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor with 152 LOC.
